// stretchy buffer // init: NULL // free: sbfree() // push_back: sbpush() // size: sbcount() //
#define sbfree(a)         ((a) ? free(rblxstb__sbraw(a)),0 : 0)
#define sbpush(a,v)       (rblxstb__sbmaybegrow(a,1), (a)[rblxstb__sbn(a)++] = (v))
#define sbcount(a)        ((a) ? rblxstb__sbn(a) : 0)
#define sbadd(a,n)        (rblxstb__sbmaybegrow(a,n), rblxstb__sbn(a)+=(n), &(a)[rblxstb__sbn(a)-(n)])
#define sblast(a)         ((a)[rblxstb__sbn(a)-1])

#include <stdlib.h>
#define rblxstb__sbraw(a) ((int *) (a) - 2)
#define rblxstb__sbm(a)   rblxstb__sbraw(a)[0]
#define rblxstb__sbn(a)   rblxstb__sbraw(a)[1]

#define rblxstb__sbneedgrow(a,n)  ((a)==0 || rblxstb__sbn(a)+n >= rblxstb__sbm(a))
#define rblxstb__sbmaybegrow(a,n) (rblxstb__sbneedgrow(a,(n)) ? rblxstb__sbgrow(a,n) : 0)
#define rblxstb__sbgrow(a,n)  rblxstb__sbgrowf((void **) &(a), (n), sizeof(*(a)))

static void rblxstb__sbgrowf(void **arr, int increment, int itemsize)
{
   int m = *arr ? 2*rblxstb__sbm(*arr)+increment : increment+1;
   void *p = realloc(*arr ? rblxstb__sbraw(*arr) : 0, itemsize * m + sizeof(int)*2);
   assert(p);
   if (p) {
      if (!*arr) ((int *) p)[1] = 0;
      *arr = (void *) ((int *) p + 2);
      rblxstb__sbm(*arr) = m;
   }
}
